summary: L-5 cab on Lake Mountain in the Siskiyou NF, built 1937 or 1938 and blown down in a 1953 windstorm; ruins may remain.

facts.status_note: Blown down in 1953; no source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1937 in the register, the Siskiyou inventory and firelookout.com; 1938 in the Forest lookout history site and the Josephine County blog. The story gives both and leads with 1937.
1953 in the register, firelookout.com, the history site and the Siskiyou inventory; the Josephine County blog gives 1954.

notes_for_editor: Dates disagree: built 1937 vs 1938, removed 1953 vs 1954. Not the Lake Mountain Lookout in Siskiyou County, California (an NHLR rock tower); keep the two apart. Source 5 is the blog home page; no post-level URL was available. Search surfaced trail listings for a Lake Mountain near Cave Junction; I did not open them, so the story makes no access or visit claim. Staffing is limited to the 1941 season.
